description: Golden evaluation benchmark dataset for Acme Enterprise Cloud employee handbook

items.query: What is the duration of the introductory probationary period for new full-time hires?
items.reference_answer: All new full-time hires are subject to an initial 90-day probationary introductory period commencing on their start date.

items.query: What is the maximum reimbursement amount for the one-time home office setup stipend?
items.reference_answer: Full-time remote employees are entitled to a one-time, non-taxable home office setup stipend of up to $750 for ergonomic chairs, desks, monitors, or headsets, claimable within 60 days of hire.

items.query: How many days of annual paid time off (PTO) do regular full-time employees receive?
items.reference_answer: Regular full-time employees receive 25 days of accrued paid time off (PTO) per calendar year, accruing at 2.08 days per full month worked.

items.query: What is the company 401(k) retirement matching percentage?
items.reference_answer: Acme provides a dollar-for-dollar 100% match on employee 401(k) contributions up to 6% of the employee's gross annual base salary, with immediate 100% vesting.

items.query: What is the minimum password length required for corporate accounts?
items.reference_answer: All corporate passwords must be at least 16 characters in length, including uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols.

items.query: What is the initial response SLA for a Severity 1 (Sev-1) incident?
items.reference_answer: Severity 1 (Sev-1) critical outages or data breaches have an initial response SLA of within 15 minutes, with executive escalation within 30 minutes.

items.query: What are the rules regarding unused PTO rollover at the end of the calendar year?
items.reference_answer: Employees may roll over a maximum of 5 unused PTO days into the following calendar year. Any unused PTO exceeding 5 days on December 31 is forfeited.

items.query: Explain the standard equity vesting schedule and cliff for corporate grants.
items.reference_answer: Equity grants follow a standard 4-year vesting schedule with a 1-year cliff where 25% vests on the first anniversary, followed by 6.25% vesting quarterly over the remaining 36 months.

items.query: What are the technical requirements for personal devices connecting to corporate resources under BYOD?
items.reference_answer: Personal devices must enroll in Microsoft Intune MDM, require biometric unlock (FaceID/fingerprint), and enforce AES-256 storage encryption. Jailbroken or rooted devices are strictly prohibited.

items.query: Describe the differences between Tier 3 Confidential data and Tier 4 Restricted data.
items.reference_answer: Tier 3 (Confidential) includes customer contracts, financials, and source code protected by RBAC. Tier 4 (Restricted) covers customer PII, cryptographic private keys, payroll data, and health records, requiring hardware MFA and VP-level approval.

items.query: What are the daily meal per diem limits for domestic versus international business travel?
items.reference_answer: The domestic daily meal per diem is capped at $75 per day ($15 breakfast, $25 lunch, $35 dinner), while the international daily meal per diem is capped at $120 per day.

items.query: What is the company policy on anonymous reporting of ethical or legal violations and retaliation?
items.reference_answer: Employees may report violations anonymously via the Acme Ethics Helpline (1-800-555-ACME). Retaliation against whistleblowers is illegal and results in immediate dismissal. Investigations are completed within 14 business days.

items.query: Who must approve business expenses exceeding $5,000, and what are the flight class restrictions?
items.reference_answer: Expenses exceeding $5,000 require Vice President (VP) and Finance Operations sign-off. Flights under 6 hours must be booked in Standard Economy, while Business class is permitted only for international flights exceeding 8 continuous hours.

items.query: What are the specific password rotation intervals, character requirements, and history constraints?
items.reference_answer: Passwords must be at least 16 characters with uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols, rotated every 90 days, and cannot reuse any of the previous 8 passwords.

items.query: What are the initial response SLAs for Sev-1, Sev-2, Sev-3, and Sev-4 incidents?
items.reference_answer: Initial response SLAs are: Sev-1 within 15 minutes, Sev-2 within 1 hour, Sev-3 within 4 business hours, and Sev-4 within 24 business hours.

items.query: How is severance calculated for involuntary restructuring separations, and what is the maximum duration cap?
items.reference_answer: Severance includes a base of 4 weeks salary plus 2 weeks salary per completed year of continuous service, capped at 26 total weeks, along with 3 months of employer-subsidized COBRA healthcare.

items.query: What hardware token requirements exist for cloud environments, and why is SMS verification forbidden?
items.reference_answer: FIDO2 / WebAuthn hardware security keys (e.g. YubiKey) are mandatory for AWS, Supabase, and GitHub environments. SMS and voice verification are strictly forbidden due to SIM-swapping vulnerabilities.

items.query: Can an employee on 90-day probation book international business travel, and what meal per diem would apply?
items.reference_answer: Employees in their 90-day probationary period are not permitted to book discretionary international business travel [Page 1]. If authorized under exception, international travel is subject to a $120/day meal per diem [Page 8].

items.query: What equipment stipends and standard computer hardware are provided to a newly hired remote software engineer?
items.reference_answer: Remote employees receive a $750 home office setup stipend and a $100 monthly connectivity subsidy [Page 2]. Standard engineering hardware is an Apple MacBook Pro 16-inch (M3 Max, 64GB RAM) or Dell Precision 5680 workstation [Page 2].

items.query: If an employee is laid off after exactly 2 years of service, how much equity has vested and what severance do they receive?
items.reference_answer: After 2 years, 50% of their equity grant will have vested (25% at the 1-year cliff plus 6.25% quarterly across the second year) [Page 4]. In an involuntary reduction, they receive 8 weeks of base salary severance (4 weeks base + 2 weeks x 2 years) and 3 months COBRA [Page 10].

items.query: If a remote employee's company laptop is stolen while traveling, what reporting timeframe applies and what incident level could this trigger?
items.reference_answer: Lost or stolen devices must be reported to the ISOC within 2 hours for a remote cryptographic wipe [Page 2]. If the laptop contained compromised Tier 4 customer data, it escalates as a Sev-1 critical incident with a 15-minute response SLA [Page 7].

items.query: Compare the time-off restrictions during the introductory probationary period with standard annual PTO rules.
items.reference_answer: During the 90-day probationary period, non-emergency PTO cannot exceed 2 consecutive days [Page 1]. Outside probation, full-time employees accrue 25 days PTO annually and must provide 2 weeks advance notice for leave of 3 or more consecutive days [Page 3].
